description: This file contains Django view classes and functions for handling invoice data, including CRUD operations, data extraction from uploaded files, email-based invoice retrieval, and generating Excel reports. It also includes API endpoints for data visualization and email file management.

classes.name: InvoiceListView
classes.description: A list view for displaying recent invoices of the logged-in user.

classes.name: InvoiceDetailView
classes.description: A detail view for a specific invoice.

classes.name: InvoiceCreateView
classes.description: A view for creating new invoice entries.

classes.name: InvoiceUpdateView
classes.description: A view for updating existing invoice entries with user permission check.

classes.name: InvoiceDeleteView
classes.description: A view for deleting invoice entries with user permission check.

classes.name: graphView
classes.description: A simple view rendering the main graph page.

classes.name: graph
classes.description: API view providing aggregated invoice data for charts.

classes.name: graphViewMonthly
classes.description: View for selecting a month to display monthly graph data.

classes.name: graphMonthly
classes.description: API view providing detailed monthly invoice data for charts.

methods.name: Invoicecompleteview
methods.description: Displays a paginated summary of invoices with total amount and counts.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters invoices by issuer company name.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches invoices by issuer company name.

methods.name: extractinvoice
methods.description: Handles file upload, extracts invoice data, and saves to database.

methods.name: checkme
methods.description: Connects to email account and lists files in upload directory.

methods.name: showdownloadedFile
methods.description: Displays and deletes a file from upload directory.

methods.name: savef
methods.description: Saves invoice data received via POST into database.

methods.name: export_users_xls
methods.description: Exports invoice data to an Excel file.

methods.name: mailExtract
methods.description: Handles file upload, extracts invoice data, and saves to database (similar to extractinvoice).
